table.purpose: Clinical registry of autoimmune/rheumatic disease patients (mostly SLE), one row per patient encounter, with lab titers, serology +/- results, diagnoses, and complications. Exact identity of the table is tentative; the content strongly suggests a lupus/autoimmunity cohort dataset.

col_001.name: patient_id
col_001.description: Near-unique integer identifier for the patient/record (763 distinct in 806 rows, ~99% unique). Not a primary key per detection, but functions as the record identifier.

col_002.name: date
col_002.description: A date between 1989 and 1998, most likely the visit/examination or registration date. Could alternatively be date of birth, but the spread over only ~9 years with many repeated dates fits a visit/record date better.

col_005.name: antibody_titer
col_005.description: Values are exclusively powers of two (0, 4, 16, 64, 256, 1024, 4096), the classic pattern of a serially diluted antibody titer (e.g., ANA or anti-dsDNA titer); 0 means not performed/negative.

col_008.name: diagnosis
col_008.description: Diagnosis of the patient, primarily autoimmune diseases: SLE (systemic lupus erythematosus), SjS (Sjögren's syndrome), RA (rheumatoid arthritis), MCTD (mixed connective tissue disease), DM (dermatomyositis), with qualifiers like 'susp' (suspected) and combined diagnoses.

col_012.name: complication
col_012.description: Free-text complication or comorbidity, mostly lupus-related: 'CNS lupus', 'brain infarction', 'AMI' (acute myocardial infarction), 'PH' (pulmonary hypertension?), 'thrombocytopenia', 'DVT' (deep vein thrombosis), 'thrombophlebitis', 'Abortion'. Present in ~10% of rows.

col_013.name: complication_count
col_013.description: Small integer 0-3, 0 in 90% of rows; plausibly the number of complications/events recorded (matches the sparsity of col_012), but this link is not proven.

table.name: water_chemistry_samples
table.purpose: One row per water sample (likely groundwater or surface water) collected between 1981 and 1999, with laboratory results for many physical and chemical parameters. Censored values ('<0.3', 'TR', '-') and 'negative' results indicate a lab-report format. The exact analyte per column cannot be determined from the data alone, so most columns are unresolved or tentative. col_001 links each sample to an entity in t03 (likely a station/well/site).

col_001.name: site_id
col_001.description: Identifier of the sampling site/station; references t03.col_001 (many samples per site). Not unique within this table.

col_002.name: sample_date
col_002.description: Date the sample was collected (1981-01-27 to 1999-03-04).

col_007.name: ph
col_007.description: pH of the sample: range 0-9.9 with mean 7.1 and a tight mode near neutral, consistent with pH units.

col_032.description: Text column mixing censored values ('<0.3', '<0.2'), placeholders ('-', '+', '2+') and plain numbers. A reported result with below-detection-limit notation; the analyte is unknown.

col_034.description: Text column with censored values ('<40', '<20.5', '<10') and plain numbers. A reported result with below-detection-limit notation; analyte unknown.

col_035.description: Integer measurement, ~61% null, range 15-196, median 69. Possibly calcium (mg/L) given typical ranges, but this is not confirmed.

col_036.description: Integer measurement, ~61% null, range 3-80, median 21. Possibly magnesium (mg/L) given typical ranges, but this is not confirmed.

table.name: patient_autoimmune_registry
table.purpose: One row per patient in a clinical registry of autoimmune/rheumatic diseases, with demographics, Rh status, and diagnosis. Referenced by t02 (many-to-one), suggesting t02 holds per-patient events or measurements linked via col_001.

col_001.name: patient_id
col_001.description: Primary key; unique integer identifier for each patient record. Referenced by t02.col_001 (many-to-one), so t02 rows attach to a patient here.

col_002.name: sex
col_002.description: Patient sex: F (1023), M (202), blank/unknown (13). Strong female predominance consistent with autoimmune disease cohorts.

col_004.name: registration_or_diagnosis_date
col_004.description: Date between 1991 and 1998, ~17% missing, low distinct count with repeated values (e.g. 1997-08-20 appears 64 times) suggesting batch entry. Likely the date the patient was registered/enrolled in the study or diagnosed; the two readings cannot be distinguished from the data alone.

col_005.name: disease_onset_date
col_005.description: Date between 1972 and 1998, ~20% missing, mostly unique. Plausibly the date of disease onset or first symptom/diagnosis; could alternatively be a follow-up or treatment start date, so the exact event is uncertain.

col_006.name: rh_blood_group
col_006.description: Rh factor: '-' (713), '+' (488), blank (34), '+(' (3, likely a data-entry error for '+').

col_007.name: diagnosis
col_007.description: Diagnosis/disease, mostly coded abbreviations of autoimmune/rheumatic diseases: SLE (systemic lupus erythematosus), SJS (Sjögren's syndrome), RA (rheumatoid arthritis), BEHCET (Behçet's disease), PSS (progressive systemic sclerosis), DM (dermatomyositis), PN (polyarteritis nodosa). Free-text variants and multi-diagnosis values ('PSS, RA') occur.
